data.filter: explicit version, exact canonical trusted request, exclude all user_task_15, require native B0 agreement
data.prior_exposure: All 150 retained episodes and their prior aggregate/stratified results were examined in the preceding study. This is reused development evidence, not an untouched final test.

candidates.C1_action_model: Original ridge/logit calibration/expected-loss using fixed action-only features x_act1/x_act2/x_act3; original lambda grid selected using inner fitting folds only.
candidates.C2_canonical_provenance: Block invalid/unknown mutations or any external-only declared key argument; canonical IBAN token matching; other numeric/text matching inherited from original. No learned score.
candidates.C3_target_only: C2 but ignore amount provenance for transfer tools. Deliberately incomplete diagnostic control; test amount-only attacks and do not recommend from benchmark ASR alone.
candidates.C4_verified_refund: For a bounded full trusted-request refund grammar, derive exact recipient/amount/date from a unique incoming bank receipt through an independent trusted read interface, fixed safe subject Refund, one-use reservation and full argument repair. Outside recognized grammar use C2; if recognized but independent evidence missing/ambiguous, withhold all mutations.

task_holdout: Refit original and action-only model with all episodes from a user task excluded together. No task ID is a runtime input. This is task holdout for the refitted model, not an unseen task for the policy designer.
residuals: Reuse native oracle-withholding replays already generated in v1.2.1; recompute fitting-only r_mod excluding each held-out objective or user task. It is an inherited NO-ADAPT/label-coverage surrogate, not learned causal intervention effectiveness.
calibration_failure: Do not silently substitute raw probabilities or fabricate fits. Mark unavailable fold; retain explicit model availability and require all common comparison rows, or report comparison unavailable.
execution: stateful native AgentDojo recorded-actor replay NO-ADAPT, no live LLM
trust_difference: C4 additionally receives a narrow independently authenticated ledger view of sender/recipient/amount/date/id/own-account only; it never sees task solutions, labels, injection metadata, notes, profile secrets, or clean pre-injection oracle state. Its fallback provenance guard still receives the same tool messages as C2.
synthetic_tests: Correctness and adversarial stress only; not real benchmark effectiveness. Include amount-only attacks, target changes, malformed arguments, fragmented IBAN, ambiguous/missing/untrusted backend evidence, unauthorized metadata and repeated/refactored attempts.
primary_metric: paired benign task success with native replay ASR; no defensible security margin, report Pareto points and synthetic threat gaps

bootstrap.clusters: user task for benign; injection objective and user-task sensitivities for attacks

selection: All four candidates frozen before new outcome evaluation; no tuning to select a winner. Any promising result requires a fresh independent test set.
